name: Reversible 1 Code
definition: Indicates the possibility to terminate the securitiesc lending contract either by the borrower or lender before the expiration date.

REVL.name: Reversible
REVL.definition: Securities lending contract can be ended by the borrower before the expiration date.

FIXD.name: Fixed
FIXD.definition: Securities lending contract can not be ended by the borrower before the expiration date.

CABK.name: Call Back
CABK.definition: Securities lending contract can be ended by the lender before the expiration date.
